steps.why: Pi as pi-agent has it: pi-dolly installs pi and the platform's documents beside the files Pi reads.

steps.script: pi --version > /dev/null && ! cc --version 2> /dev/null && amy installed | grep -q '^pi ' && test -s /home/dolly/.pi/agent/SYSTEM.md && test -s /home/dolly/.pi/agent/extensions/dolly-tools.js && test -s /usr/share/doc/dolly/docs/slop.md
